Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail

Class ThymeleafOttMailer

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.mail.ThymeleafOttMailer
All Implemented Interfaces:
OttDelivery
public class ThymeleafOttMailer extends Object implements OttDelivery
OttDelivery that e-mails one-time codes and magic links as multipart messages (plain text and HTML) rendered with Thymeleaf. Only OttChannel.EMAIL is handled: asking it to deliver through another channel is a programming error and is refused with an IllegalArgumentException, so a token is never silently dropped. Subject and texts come from a MessageSource resolved with the explicitly configured locale, never the platform's default. A delivery failure becomes an OttDeliveryException with a generic message and a sanitized cause: neither the address, nor the code, nor the link is ever logged or carried by an exception.
